senses.definition: To transfer the possession of an object to someone else.

examples.text: Mi puoi dare il sale, per favore?
examples.translation: Can you hand me the salt, please?
examples.emotion: polite and friendly, asking for help at the dinner table

senses.definition: To hit or bump into something.

examples.text: Attento a non dare la testa contro la porta.
examples.translation: Be careful not to bump your head against the door.
examples.emotion: concerned and warning someone in a hurry

faults.quote: to give; to hit; to turn
faults.why: 'To turn' is not in the senses; sense 2 is 'to face / look out onto'.

faults.quote: Dare is one of the most common irregular verbs in Italian.
faults.why: Calls the verb irregular without giving the learner any of its irregular forms.

faults.quote: Attento a non dare la testa contro la porta.
faults.why: 'Sbattere la testa' is normal for bumping one's head; 'dare una festa/un esame' is much more useful.
